displayProfile.description: Absolute host path to an explicit owner-declared Claude display manifest. Pins display executable, argv and presentation for this launch; does not inspect or modify global statusLine. Callback data is display evidence, not backend freshness or account permission.

profile.description: Immutable requested task profile; null for pre-migration records. This is not a restored native grant or a claim that rejected settings were applied.

maxAttempts.description: Total dispatch generations, including the first.

maxDelayMs.description: At least initialDelayMs; enforced at the command boundary.

jobRetryDecision.description: Immutable outgoing retry decision facts. These do not authorize replay; current occurrence state identifies waiting, cancellation or a later generation.

executionTimeoutMs.description: Optional per-generation execution window from native launch admission; excludes prechecks and remains independent of maxElapsedMs. An accepted explicit worker report before the deadline disarms it.

executionTimeout.description: Current generation's retained timeout evidence, or null without a timeout; historical accepted envelopes may omit this field. Cleanup acceptance is not observed native exit.

launchReconciliation.description: Inspected exact-generation launch cleanup descriptor. Only available:true with its current digest permits an explicit owner acknowledgement. Historical accepted envelopes may omit this field.

launchResolution.description: Retained owner acknowledgement releasing logical overlap after an exact no-effect launch. This does not prove exit, complete a native stop, retry work or undo precheck effects. Historical accepted envelopes may omit this field.

executionTimeoutMs.description: Immutable execution window accepted for this occurrence; omission preserves legacy behavior.

approvalRevision.description: Observed approval revision for generation 2 and later, or null when unavailable; omitted from legacy generation-1 records.

quotaWake.description: Retained owner-authorized one-shot native Codex continuation. Configured-reader evidence is not an immutable provider account lease. Operation settlement does not establish task success; restart pauses automatic authority.

jobQuotaPolicy.description: Explicit owner opt-in to configured-reader quota admission; currently Codex only. Requires jobQuotaAdmission:true. Reader observations are not an immutable native-account lease or a guarantee of provider acceptance. Omission preserves legacy intent.

jobQuotaDecision.description: Additive retained quota admission evidence. Historical accepted envelopes may omit it. Waiting does not imply a native effect or authorize retry; reader eligibility does not guarantee provider acceptance.

name.description: Nonempty repository/worktree label, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; runtime validation enforces byte length.

branch.description: Actual symbolic branch label, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; runtime validation enforces byte length.
